description: The bar chart compares the number of FLOPs (Floating Point Operations) for different methods, including Full FT, TAG, LoRA, MTL-FT, QLoRA, and Ours. The x-axis contains the categories, labeled in the order: Full FT, TAG, LoRA, MTL-FT, QLoRA, and Ours. The y-axis is labeled "# FLOPs" and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10^18 to 10^20. The bars are colored orange, except for the "Ours" category, which is green. The bar heights represent the number of FLOPs, with values ranging from approximately 3 x 10^18 for QLoRA and Ours to 8 x 10^19 for Full FT. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, but rather follow the order of the categories on the x-axis. The bar for "Ours" is slightly taller than that of QLoRA. The chart title is "QLoRA".
